title: Cheapest Flights Within K Stops
constraints: Every flight endpoint is a valid city; no flight goes from a city to itself.
Each ordered pair of cities has at most one listed flight.
inputFormat: Implement findCheapestPrice(n, flights, src, dst, k). Each flight is [from, to, price]; cities are numbered 0 through n - 1.
outputFormat: The cheapest price using at most k intermediate stops (k + 1 flights), or -1 if unreachable. If src equals dst, return 0.
